findings.scope: US087 typed Truss bulk adapter adoption; preserve original provider API while this is fixed
findings.title: ManifestBulkPlan drops required original control outcomes and submission identity
findings.failure: A materialize or submit control transaction commits but acknowledgement is lost. seal()->Manifest / submit(manifest)->BulkJob cannot return the original ControlUnknown recovery reference; submission also has no public caller-key or specified stable-key capture despite TD087 requiring one. A wrapper throwing a generic error or issuing a fresh seal/key loses original custody and can create different work. Known control failures/refusals/conflicts are likewise unspecified.
findings.correction: Define the full seal/submit result or typed exception mapping with original immutable ControlRecoveryRef, protected-safe code and retained exact result; expose or explicitly capture the original submission key and durable attempt capability. Provide an engine-delegating recovery path. Never retry/re-materialize on unknown. Add seal/submit ACK-loss, known-noncommit, TOKEN_REUSE, refusal and original-recovery tests to AC6.

findings.scope: US087 typed action adapter adoption; current engine result must remain complete
findings.title: Action outcome projection cannot satisfy promised native code and outcome preservation
findings.failure: Native conflict TOKEN_REUSE versus EXPECTED_VERSION is reduced to Conflict(retained), and denied(code) becomes bare Denied, although TD/STP087 demand original codes. A committed net no-op is exposed as business change committed with output/receipt only, discarding native revision/changes/noOp/verification. Original replay cannot recover that omitted meaning through the stated API.
findings.correction: Retain the complete original engine result in an immutable tagged carrier, with typed projections as convenience views; require protected-safe codes on Conflict/Denied and preserve noOp/verification/change/revision information. Define Indeterminate as engine-specific unknown, not universally nonreconcilable, and retain original keyed request for host-owned resolution. Add same-key replay and no-op/code-preservation controls.

findings.scope: US086/087 catalog command contract and W0 output dependency; not current free-SQL browser execution
findings.title: Catalog variant artifact shape only describes reads, not original mutation-plan input
findings.failure: A Truss command must retain an original CONTRACT902 plan and complete selection lowering, including preflights/typed parameters/identity-Key-version output/bounds/obligations. The currently specified artifact choices are native SQL or truss-page; those do not represent this command carrier. Implementers must invent a shape or replace the original mutation artifact with a read-page/statement summary. Digest comparison is also inconsistent between lowered selection only and plan-plus-lowering.
findings.correction: Define a separate command variant that retains the exact original plan and owner lowering result plus complete source/action/preparation/backend pins. Specify one Weft-owned versioned structural-digest projection including all non-value meaning; bind both catalog and instantiation to it. Until WR-I3/W0 supplies that surface, refuse this SDK catalog path rather than hash stripped SQL or plan bytes locally.

followUpRequirements.topic: Local profile versus native SDK target
followUpRequirements.detail: C069/TD087 describe native authenticated-subject/role tx1 and native-client witnesses. Browser local-owner/local-tx/local-bulk must have its own explicitly admitted targetProfile and adoption witnesses; kind truss, never pretend raw postgresql/native-session/person. Current CONTRACT905 already establishes that separation; no broadened/native qualification is claimed.

Adding CONTRACT070 views changes full model bytes and currently relevant unknown semantic closure. Keep original b8/6f5e/633f immutable. Future SDK annotated model requires original extension interpretation, a new owner preparation/source cohort, new Weft pins and Truss catalog admission; never strip the extension or edit hashes.

WR-A9 and U3 are planned expansion, not current support. CONTRACT902:62 requires a new profile for future subsets; C905 remains constant required scalar set first proof. Required malformed/missing stored rows must continue to fail complete-population preflights; future S2 UNKNOWN behavior for legitimately nullable/missing Fields cannot reinterpret required-row corruption.

CONTRACT073:35-42,128-141 applies only raw-table targets and explicitly excludes Truss/Ashlar. Its no-manifest execute/atomicity/idempotency/reconciliation model cannot replace local-bulk custody. It does not force current demo architecture changes.

Keep current source/profile/binding/revision ownership checks at engine admission and effect transaction, original Key byte identity and full-first [2,1] partition. SDK target.verify or structural digest is not current native authorization, seal or original control custody.
